subject: add option to use libbacktrace for backtraces in crash reports (#3034)
reason: The change is entirely behind a new compile-time flag USE_LIBBACKTRACE (default no) that the runner's standard build does not set, so the new symbolizeWithLibbacktrace code in src/debug.c is compiled out of both binaries under test. Everything else in the diff is CI workflow, .gitignore and README edits.
